title: One-Shot Clustering for Federated Learning Under Clustering-Agnostic Assumption
abstract: arXiv:2509.01587v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a widespread and well-adopted paradigm of decentralised learning that allows training one model from multiple sources without the need to transfer data between participating clients directly. Since its inception in 2016, it has been divided into numerous subfields that deal with application-specific issues, such as data heterogeneity or resource allocation. One such sub-field, Clustered Federated Learning (CFL), is dealing with the problem of clustering the population of clients into separate cohorts to deliver personalised models. Although a few remarkable works have been published in this domain, the problem remains largely unexplored, as its basic assumptions and settings differ slightly from those of standard FL. translated_title: 聚类无关假设下的联邦学习一次性聚类
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种被广泛采用的去中心化学习范式，它允许从多个数据源训练同一个模型，而无需在参与客户端之间直接传输数据。自2016年诞生以来，联邦学习已分化出众多子领域，用以处理特定应用的问题，例如数据异构性或资源分配。其中一个子领域——聚类联邦学习（CFL）——致力于解决将客户端群体划分为不同群组以提供个性化模型的问题。尽管该领域已发表了一些杰出的工作，但这一问题在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，因为其基本假设和设置与标准联邦学习略有不同。在本工作中，我们提出了一次性聚类联邦学习（OCFL），这是一种聚类无关的算法，能够自动检测出适合进行聚类的最早时机。我们通过实验验证……
tldr: 本文提出了一种聚类无关的一次性聚类联邦学习算法（OCFL），能够自动检测出最适合聚类的最早时机，从而实现个性化模型的训练。
